data.name: CarbonChip
data.description: Carbonchip is a small Brisbane-based biochar manufacturer, established in 2020, producing biochar from forestry residues via a mobile pyrolysis unit for Queensland farms and national customers. Its Mobile Carboniser #1 project is listed on Puro.earth with CORC 100+ durability certification and sits at "Early development" status. The company is very small (~2 employees) but has retail distribution (e.g. Fernland) and ongoing CORC issuance activity.
